name: s3-put-object-empty-content
source: Fix 884e44b: s3_put_object rejected an empty content string
prompt: s3_put_object answers "Either filePath or content must be provided." when a client sends content as an empty string. An empty string is valid base64 for a zero-byte object, so the tool should store a zero-byte object instead. Fix it test-first and run the tests before you finish.
